title: Restore the five chart-268 exit values with an earlier paid return
body:
## Mathematical result

Rebinding 2678 at grade two to a retimed 182→0 contact lets 1464 carry native X1464+X1584 to chart 268. The literal word restores old 1931, 1932, 1933, 1935 and 1936, and owners 221, 679 and 411 in both orientations. The full diagnostics still differ on 66 forward and 23 adjoint rows. Its conditional price margin is +36.1548121757, yet the fixed topology is short one independent dimension at each of charts 0 and 1. Granting arbitrary recoding, no funded addition-only or single-extra-retarget repair closes both. A separate clocked support proof treats the pure-1584 family and the 206 displaced-packet cases use a deterministic repair policy.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. The original clocked family and the new retimed constructive diagnostic are different scopes.

## Validation

Both fresh source manifests and associated Python verification commands passed, including literal 680-row operators, both invoices, 634 frozen-stock collisions and positive/negative sink controls.

## Open next questions

Find a coupled edited incidence or altered paid interface that restores both missing dimensions and all older outputs. This diagnostic does not qualify κ.
